title: Frequency, Default History and Program Combination Limits of the Payment Arrangements Tiers
content:
Credit and Collections Policy, limits table — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements).

| Tier | Agreements of any tier accepted on one service account in a rolling 12 months | Default lookback | Defaulted agreements the member may have in the lookback | Agreements offered or active on one service account at a time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | 2 | 12 months | 0 | 1 |
| Extended Hardship Payment Agreement | 1 | 12 months | 1 | 1 |
| Winter Protection Payment Agreement | 1 | 12 months | 1 | 1 |
| Medical Certificate Payment Agreement | 2 | 12 months | 1 | 1 |
| Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | 1 | 12 months | 0 | 1 |
| Commercial Installment Agreement | 1 | 12 months | 0 | 1 |

| Combination or change | Every tier |
|---|---|
| May coexist with a PrePay Power enrollment on the service account | no |
| May coexist with an active Budget Billing plan on the service account | no |
| Terms of an active agreement may be changed | no |

**Meaning of the limits**

- The *rolling 12-month count* is the number of agreements of any tier that may be accepted on one service account in a rolling 12 months.
- The *default lookback* is the number of months over which the member's defaulted agreements are counted, and the *defaulted agreements allowed* is the most the member may have in that lookback.
- *At a time* limits the agreements that may be offered or active on one service account at once.
- PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) and Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) do not combine with any tier on the same service account, and no tier allows the terms of an active agreement to be renegotiated.

**Reading the table** — a member with one defaulted agreement in the lookback is within the limit of the Extended Hardship, Winter Protection and Medical Certificate tiers (1 allowed) and outside the limit of the Standard, Agricultural Harvest and Commercial Installment tiers (0 allowed).
